events.result:
Batch 3 migrated, 40 records (120 migrated so far).
Validation note: the old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM
assumed every number was domestic and saved it with a +1 prefix. 31 of the 120
records migrated so far belong to overseas customers, so their phone numbers in the
new CRM are wrong. Records from batches 4 to 10 will have the same problem.
New CRM activity: 14 sales users have opened customer records in the last 24 hours.

args.body: Migration paused after batch 3: 120 of 400 records migrated. Validation reports that the new CRM automatically added +1 to numbers lacking country codes; 31 overseas customers among the 120 now have incorrect phone numbers. Batches 4–10 (280 records) would have the same issue. Fourteen sales users opened customer records in the last 24 hours; whether they used affected numbers is unknown. Please coordinate an immediate warning to sales not to rely on migrated overseas phone numbers. Recommended next steps: identify the 31 affected records and verify their country codes, authorize audited corrections, and resolve the country-code mapping before migrating the remaining batches. No phone corrections have been made.

Morgan Lee has been notified immediately because sales may rely on these records. Corrections and a mapping fix are needed before the remaining 280 records can be migrated.
